name: No evidence of real operations
description: Business shows little or no staff, premises, web presence or client base consistent with its stated activities and turnover.
fp: Small consultancies or home-based businesses may have a light footprint; request supporting contracts and invoices.

links.ctx: Company lacks staff, premises, website, supplier payments or payroll despite substantial turnover.
links.fp: Holding companies and start-ups have little activity.

links.ctx: Foreign IT-services firm has limited verifiable clients and unclear service delivery.
